reconciliation.notes: The official store advertises 65+ powerups rather than an exact catalog count.
The English vanilla table enumerates 67 rows, including Quick Shot.
The Japanese index enumerates 66 linked pages and omits Quick Shot; its individual pages otherwise corroborate the public pool.
The clean-room runtime exposes random drafts rather than a complete catalog browser, so full current-build enumeration remains an explicit gap.

patchHistory.scope: Increased Dazzle duration by 25%; changed Lifestealer drain, Leech wording, Careful Planning cadence, Poison ammunition and damage, Parasite health, Toxic Cloud damage, Healing Field activation, Grow distance and cap, Abyssal Countdown trigger and duration, Cold Bullets duplicate stacking beyond two copies, and Shield Charge range independence from health.
patchHistory.binding: The post-patch numeric values replace older guide values. Dazzle duration is 25% longer than before the patch. The relative Abyssal Countdown timing changes, Cold Bullets beyond-two stacking, and health-independent Shield Charge range are binding constraints; their undisclosed exact values or formulas remain unresolved.

patchHistory.scope: Corrected bullets that did not grow properly under some card effects.
patchHistory.binding: Growth behavior is part of the current build even where older footage shows the rendering defect.
